newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AND Int. Publishers to list in Amsterdam.
newsitem.headline: AND Int. Publishers to list in Amsterdam.

text.p: AND International Publishers Plc of Oxford, England, said on Monday its ordinary shares would be listed on the Amsterdam stock exchange from December 12.
AND also said it had placed 600,000 ordinary shares with an unidentified Dutch investor on Monday at a price of 100 pence per share.
Prior to the placement there had been 20.7 million ordinary shares outstanding.
AND said its shares had been listed on the Alternative Investment Market (AIM) in London since July 31.
The Amsterdam listing, sponsored by Rabo Securities NV, is intended to make trading in the shares more liquid.
AND's main businesses are the publication of reference works in electronic formats, mapping and electronic identification systems.
In 1995 the company had turnover of some 15 million guilders and a pre-tax profit of 1.4 million guilders.
